summary: McLaren's constructors' title charge intensifies as Norris and Piastri navigate their newly clarified team orders, with the papaya pair hunting Ferrari on Monza's high-speed straights. Mercedes and Ferrari circle for advantage in the midfield battle, where pit strategy and DRS deployment could fracture the leading teams' composure. A victory here would hand McLaren crucial momentum in their championship sprint, potentially reshaping the final third of the season with Norris and Piastri operating in tandem.
